# Delhi Dental Cosmetics

> Dental clinic in GTB Nagar, North Delhi, led by Dr. Animesh Agarwal (17+ years) and Dr. Neha Singhal. Cosmetic and complete health dentistry: dental implants, braces and clear aligners, smile makeovers and veneers, single-sitting root canals, zirconia crowns and bridges, teeth whitening, gum treatment, and family dentistry. Rated 4.9 across 881 Google reviews. Address: 2413 Basement, Hudson Lane, Kingsway Camp, GTB Nagar, Delhi 110009, near GTB Nagar Metro Station Gate 4. Phone +91 95605 53331. Open Monday to Saturday 9:30 AM to 1:30 PM and 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM; Sunday closed. Appointments required; wheelchair accessible; Paytm accepted.

## Facts patients ask about
- Root canal treatment: usually single-sitting where the case allows; Delhi price context in the patient guide
- Dental implants: planned on X-ray first; full cost quoted before work begins
- Braces and aligners: both offered; choice depends on case complexity and wear discipline
- Whitening: in-clinic peroxide whitening; realistic shade targets discussed first
